passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.1
passages.text: Prima Syracosio dignata est ludere versu,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.2
passages.text: nostra nec erubuit silvas habitare Thalia.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.3
passages.text: Cum canerem reges et proelia, Cynthius aurem

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.4
passages.text: vellit, et admonuit: “Pastorem, Tityre, pinguis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.5
passages.text: pascere oportet ovis, deductum dicere carmen.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.6
passages.text: Nunc ego—namque super tibi erunt, qui dicere laudes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.7
passages.text: Vare, tuas cupiant, et tristia condere bella—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.8
passages.text: agrestem tenui meditabor arundine Musam.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.9
passages.text: Non iniussa cano: si quis tamen haec quoque, si quis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.10
passages.text: captus amore leget, te nostrae, Vare, myricae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.11
passages.text: te nemus omne canet; nec Phoebo gratior ulla est,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.12
passages.text: quam sibi quae Vari praescripsit pagina nomen.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.13
passages.text: Pergite, Pierides! Chromis et Mnasyllos in antro

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.14
passages.text: Silenum pueri somno videre iacentem,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.15
passages.text: inflatum hesterno venas, ut semper, Iaccho:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.16
passages.text: serta procul tantum capiti delapsa iacebant,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.17
passages.text: et gravis attrita pendebat cantharus ansa.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.18
passages.text: Adgressi—nam saepe senex spe carminis ambo

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.19
passages.text: luserat—iniciunt ipsis ex vincula sertis:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.20
passages.text: addit se sociam, timidisque supervenit Aegle,—

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.21
passages.text: Aegle, Naiadum pulcherrima,—iamque videnti

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.22
passages.text: sanguineis frontem moris et tempora pingit.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.23
passages.text: Ille dolum ridens, “Quo vincula nectitis?” inquit;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.24
passages.text: “solvite me, pueri; satis est potuisse videri:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.25
passages.text: carmina, quae voltis, cognoscite; carmina vobis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.26
passages.text: huic aliud mercedis erit.” Simul incipit ipse.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.27
passages.text: Tum vero in numerum Faunosque ferasque videres

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.28
passages.text: ludere, tum rigidas motare cacumina quercus;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.29
passages.text: nec tantum Phoebo gaudet Parnasia rupes,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.30
passages.text: nec tantum Rhodope miratur et Ismarus Orphea.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.31
passages.text: Namque canebat, uti magnum per inane coacta

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.32
passages.text: semina terrarumque animaeque marisque fuissent,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.33
passages.text: et liquidi simul ignis; ut his exordia primis

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.34
passages.text: omnia et ipse tener mundi concreverit orbis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.35
passages.text: tum durare solum et discludere Nerea ponto

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.36
passages.text: coeperit, et rerum paulatim sumere formas;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.37
passages.text: iamque novum terrae stupeant lucescere solem,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.38
passages.text: altius atque cadant submotis nubibus imbres;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.39
passages.text: incipiant silvae cum primum surgere, cumque

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.40
passages.text: rara per ignaros errent animalia montis.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.41
passages.text: Hinc lapides Pyrrhae iactos, Saturnia regna,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.42
passages.text: Caucasiasque refert volucres, furtumque Promethei:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.43
passages.text: his adiungit, Hylan nautae quo fonte relictum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.44
passages.text: clamassent, ut litus “Hyla, Hyla!” omne sonaret.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.45
passages.text: et fortunatam, si numquam armenta fuissent,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.46
passages.text: Pasiphaen nivei solatur amore iuvenci.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.47
passages.text: ah, virgo infelix, quae te dementia cepit!

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.48
passages.text: Proetides inplerunt falsis mugitibus agros:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.49
passages.text: at non tam turpis pecudum tamen ulla secuta est

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.50
passages.text: concubitus, quamvis collo timuisset aratrum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.51
passages.text: et saepe in levi quaesisset cornua fronte.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.52
passages.text: ah, virgo infelix, tu nunc in montibus erras:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.53
passages.text: ille, latus niveum molli fultus hyacintho,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.54
passages.text: ilice sub nigra pallentis ruminat herbas,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.55
passages.text: aut aliquam in magno sequitur grege. “Claudite, nymphae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.56
passages.text: Dictaeae nymphae, nemorum iam claudite saltus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.57
passages.text: si qua forte ferant oculis sese obvia nostris

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.58
passages.text: errabunda bovis vestigia; forsitan illum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.59
passages.text: aut herba captum viridi, aut armenta secutum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.60
passages.text: perducant aliquae stabula ad Gortynia vaccae.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.61
passages.text: Tum canit Hesperidum miratam mala puellam;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.62
passages.text: tum Phaethontiades musco circumdat amaro

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.63
passages.text: corticis, atque solo proceras erigit alnos.

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.64
passages.text: Tum canit, errantem Permessi ad flumina Gallum

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.65
passages.text: Aonas in montis ut duxerit una sororum,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.66
passages.text: utque viro Phoebi chorus adsurrexerit omnis;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.67
passages.text: ut Linus haec illi, divino carmine pastor,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.68
passages.text: floribus atque apio crinis ornatus amaro,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.69
passages.text: dixerit: “Hos tibi dant calamos, en accipe, Musae,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.70
passages.text: Ascraeo quos ante seni, quibus ille solebat

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.71
passages.text: cantando rigidas deducere montibus ornos:

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.72
passages.text: his tibi Grynei nemoris dicatur origo,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.73
passages.text: ne quis sit lucus, quo se plus iactet Apollo.”

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.74
passages.text: Quid loquar aut Scyllam Nisi, quam fama secuta est

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.75
passages.text: candida succinctam latrantibus inguina monstris

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.76
passages.text: Dulichias vexasse rates, et gurgite in alto,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.77
passages.text: ah, timidos nautas canibus lacerasse marinis,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.78
passages.text: aut ut mutatos Terei narraverit artus;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.79
passages.text: quas illi Philomela dapes, quae dona pararit,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.80
passages.text: quo cursu deserta petiverit, et quibus ante

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.81
passages.text: infelix sua tecta supervolitaverit alis?

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.82
passages.text: Omnia, quae Phoebo quondam meditante, beatus

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.83
passages.text: audiit Eurotas, iussitque ediscere laurus,

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.84
passages.text: ille canit: pulsae referunt ad sidera valles;

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.85
passages.text: cogere donec ovis stabulis numerumque referri

passages.label: Verg. Ecl. 6.86
passages.text: iussit, et invito processit Vesper Olympo.
